svg.title: When is a route worth asking for?
svg.desc: What each model and effort setting cost on four bench tasks, what a tokenwise route costs from three session settings, and the task sizes at which a route costs more than it saves, saves one to two times its cost, or saves more than twice its cost.
svg.text: When is a route worth asking for?
A tokenwise route recommends a model and effort level for a piece of work. The answer has a cost of its own,
so it pays only on work big enough for the cheaper setting to save more than that.
What each setting cost, task by task
Median list-price cost per run, 1 to 3 runs per setting. Every run shown passed its grader.
the setting it moves you from
Implement a feature from a written spec
Review a six-file diff with five planted defects
Rename a function across code, tests and README
Fix a planted bug with a failing test
What asking for a route costs
A route in a session already under way, one run per setting. It runs on the session’s own model and effort.
Where a route pays for itself
By what the task would cost on the setting you are on. The recommended setting saved a median 70% on the four tasks above. The bands assume
the same share at any size. Each dot is one of those tasks, on its starting setting.

rect.title: Sonnet 5, medium: costs more than it saves below $0.05
Sonnet 5, medium: saves one to two times its cost between $0.05 and $0.11
Sonnet 5, medium: saves more than twice its cost above $0.11
Opus 5, high: costs more than it saves below $0.14
Opus 5, high: saves one to two times its cost between $0.14 and $0.28
Opus 5, high: saves more than twice its cost above $0.28

review on Opus 5, high: $0.82; the recommended setting saved $0.57 and the route cost $0.10

Opus 5, xhigh: saves more than twice its cost above $0.31

circle.title: chore on Opus 5, xhigh: $0.25; the recommended setting saved $0.17 and the route cost $0.11
implement on Opus 5, xhigh: $1.65; the recommended setting saved $1.36 and the route cost $0.11

svg.text: What the task would cost on the setting you are on (log scale)
small gain: saves one to two times its cost
saves more than twice its cost
Already on the setting a route recommends? Then the route saves nothing, at any task size.
Tasks: Claude Code 2.1.263, 2.1.270, run 8 September 2026, 14 September 2026. Routes: tokenwise SKILL.md 8660439edb7e, Claude Code 2.1.270, run 15 September 2026.
Dollars are Claude Code’s list-price figures; on a subscription they are a weighting for comparing settings. The bench’s tasks are small.
Reproduce with node bench/breakeven.mjs at github.com/ces0491/tokenwise.
